content: Kulusha byoshi, mpûnyire nti bashenge, baharâmye, basengere, banavugire abantu boshi omunkwa:
abâmi n’abarhegesi boshi, lyo rhubona akalamo k’omurhûla buzira kavulindi, omu bukombêdu n’omu bugula.
Okwo kuli kwinjà kunasîmîsa Omuciza wîrhu Nyamuzinda,
olonza abantu boshi bacunguke banahash’imanya eby’okuli.
Bulya Nyamuzinda abà muguma yêne; n’omwimangizi ekarhî ka Nyamuzinda n’abantu naye abà muguma, anali muntu, ye Kristu Yezu,
oku bantu boshi. Obwo bwo buhamîrizi Nnâmahanga yêne ahânaga omu mango ali erhi atwîre,
bwo nanarholeragwa mpu mbè mujà-bugo na ntumwa yâbo, -ndesire okuli, ntanywêrha-, mpu nyigîrize abapagani obuyêmêre n’okuli.
Nêci, nnonzize abalume bakâshenga hoshi hoshi, bakâlambûlira amaboko gâbo gacîre e­nyanya, buzira karhinda na buzira nnongwè.
Abakazi nabo bayambale emyambalo ebakwânîne, babè n’obukenge n’o­lugero; baleke okukâhunga emviri zâbo n’okukâyambala amasholo nîsi erhi amagerha n’emishangi y’engulo ndârhi;
Ci bakaz’ishîbirira ebijiro binjà, nka kulya kunashingânîne abakazi bacîderha bakombêdu.
Amango g’enyigîrizo, kukwânîne omukazi ahulike n’obukenge. ­
Ntahiri omukazi obuyêmêre bw’okuyigîriza erhi okurhegeka omulume; ahulike.
K’arhali Adamu ye warhangag’ilemwa, na Eva akulikira?
Arhanali Adamu warhebagwa; ci omukazi erhi abà amarhebwa, ahirima omu câha.
Ci kwônene ayish’icunguka omu kubà muzîre, caziga ayôrhe ali mucêse omu buyêmêre n’omu buzigire n’omu butagatîfu.

footnotes.text: 2, 6 mpongano oku bantu boshi: Olufù lwa Yezu Kristu co cimanyîso cirhuyêreka oku Nyamuzinda alonza abantu boshi bacunguke.
